cases.sentence: Когда ковчег завета Господа прибыл в лагерь, все израильтяне подняли такой ___, что земля откликнулась эхом.
cases.explain: «громкий крик» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

cases.sentence: Это же Тот Бог, Который поразил египтян в пустыне ___.
cases.explain: «всяческими наказаниями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

cases.explain: «пеших воинов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

cases.sentence: В тот же ___ один вениамитянин бежал с места сражения и пришел в Шило.
cases.explain: «самый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.
